method: Read-only local source/requirements audit, plus the separately authorized isolated-source replay regression validation. No live acceptance or whole-repository validation performed here.

largestNextImplementation.present: The shared library/CLI/HTTP/Telegram operations validate exact stored checkout evidence and read the already prepared current private cart using caller-supplied mappings.
largestNextImplementation.missing: A live Lazada layout adapter that discovers exact selected line identities and source-bound price/quantity fields, plus a durable planner to enumerate and cache relevant SKU/quantity/voucher/payment-condition scenarios.
nextDraftAcceptance: Decode actual checkout SKU identity from original text/attributes/embedded data with source pointers; supplied expected SKU cannot attest an unobserved source identity.
Reconcile every exact line subtotal, applied merchandise/freight discount, destination, shipping and checkout total; preserve current staleness and cold-chain exclusions.
Persist scenario identity, observation, source hashes, unresolved failures and coverage; resume unseen scenarios and reuse unchanged originals at configured pacing.
Retain prepared-page read-only capture. No purchases or irreversible payment actions. Any future cart preparation must be explicit and reversible.
Keep captured-subset rankings labelled as such until relevant combinations and real eligibility are proved.

remainingImplementationAcceptance.mechanics: Provider-versioned caches, resumable catalog jobs, numerical/unit/entity checks, source-preserving reviewed chunk overlays and shared comparison rendering are implemented.
remainingImplementationAcceptance.acceptance: Configure an actual provider without persisting credentials; translate and semantically review all required current catalog text. Fixture translations and automatic numeric checks do not prove fluent complete English.

remainingImplementationAcceptance.mechanics: Authorized private chats and shared structured operations have local Bot API fixture coverage.
remainingImplementationAcceptance.acceptance: Deploy the bot with operator-provided token/allowlist and prove real authorized library-equivalent commands, restart handling and challenge behavior. Local mocks do not establish deployment.

remainingImplementationAcceptance.mechanics: The targeted replay/guard regressions below passed; parent is coordinating challenge changes, full suites and public archival.
remainingImplementationAcceptance.acceptance: Require complete unit/native E2E/lint/format/duplication and original/public archive consistency receipts tied to the final unchanged runtime, then commit/publish all safe data and test fixtures.

remainingExternalEvidenceAcceptance: Authoritative category/listing/exact-SKU inventory coverage and manual original-page audits.
Current exact manufacturer flavour/package/formula identity and all mass/volume/protein/ingredients; no density or historical formula transfer.
Actual Nha Trang quantity-specific freight, current stock/caps, frozen delivery and applied offer/voucher eligibility.
Exact bonus-food identity, amount, formula and unconditional eligibility; potential gifts remain excluded from denominators.

testLiveAcceptedIsOnlySmoke.finding: The test:live accepted flag checks for a priced capture in both categories, separately from purchaseComparisonReady. README names this a small smoke check; do not interpret it as full production or buying acceptance.

basketCoverageIsSubsetOnly.finding: A cheapest captured basket does not establish cheapest whole-market bulk order.

englishChecksAreNotSemanticApproval.finding: Exact figures and entity preservation are necessary checks; accepted human reviews remain required.

oldAuditIsDated.finding: Existing coverage counts are a dated input, not freshly audited inventory. This review does not replace or refresh the parent-owned global audit.

sameOriginalRequirements: Same attached original evidence ID and 64-hex original HTML digest
Unchanged positive net mass and paid count
Old automatic mass-only hold; fresh selected per-inner basis safe without independent quantity holds
authorizedSourceReplayFix.retained: Explicit holds, manual pending quantity review, count conflict, source invalidation, changed original evidence, fresh ambiguity/contradiction and unrelated pending fields remain unresolved. No facts, price, nutrition or gifts are approved by this helper.
